decisions.why: Page 13 is not slack, it is a PAGINATION artefact: Part 1 closes with a five-line list that lands alone on a sheet because Part 2 opens the next one. 1217px is far past what a 90-180px character can make read as deliberate — art here would look like an apology for an empty page. Fix the packing instead.
540px at the foot of a Q&A column, after the last answer of a group. A natural pause, and the widest slack in Part 2 — a character reads as deliberate here.
466px under the close of a group. Adjacent to page 41's character, so a doodle rather than a second character keeps the density falling as the policy requires.
424px at the end of a Part 1 section, under short content. Exactly the case the policy calls slack.

Page 1 is the cover. Its 411px is a measurement artefact of the .cvfit transform, which leaves the layout box at full height while the painted content is scaled to 71%; the sheet is in fact full. The cover also carries its own emblem and seal, so a doodle would compete with them.
